## Failure to reach agreement – general

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > Failure to reach agreement – general] 7.48 Where the parties do not reach an agreement on the damages to be paid within the periods specified in paragraphs 7.32 to 7.34, the claimant must send to the defendant the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form which must contain—

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > Failure to reach agreement – general] (a) in Part A, the final schedule of the claimant’s losses and the defendant’s responses comprising only the figures specified during the periods in paragraphs 7.32 to 7.34, together with supporting comments and evidence from both parties on any disputed heads of damage; and

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > Failure to reach agreement – general] (b) in Part B, the final offer and counter offer from the Stage 2 Settlement Pack Form.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > Failure to reach agreement – general] 7.49 Comments in the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A) Form must not raise anything that has not been raised in the Stage 2 Settlement Pack Form.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > Failure to reach agreement – general] 7.50 The defendant should then check that the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form complies with paragraphs 7.48 to 7.49. If the defendant considers that the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form does not comply it must be returned to the claimant within 5 days with an explanation as to why it does not comply.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > Failure to reach agreement – general] 7.51 Where the defendant intends to nominate a legal representative to accept service the name and address of the legal representative should be provided in the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A) Form.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > Failure to reach agreement – general] 7.52 Where the defendant fails to return the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form within the period in paragraph 7.50, the claimant should assume that the defendant has no further comment to make.

## Non-settlement payment by the defendant at the end of Stage 2

## 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] (1) the final offer of damages made by the defendant in the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form less any—

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] (a) deductible amount which is payable to the CRU; and

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] (b) previous interim payment(s);

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] (2) any unpaid Stage 1 fixed costs in rule Table 11 in Practice Direction 45;

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] (3) the Stage 2 fixed costs in Table 11 in Practice Direction 45; and

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] (4) the disbursements in rule 45.58 that have been agreed.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] 7.54 Where the amount of a disbursement is not agreed the defendant must pay such amount for the disbursement as the defendant considers reasonable.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] 7.55 Subject to paragraphs 7.56 and 7.57 the defendant must pay the amounts in paragraph 7.53 and 7.54 within 15 days of receiving the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form from the claimant.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] 7.56 Paragraph 7.57 applies where the defendant is required to make the payments in paragraph 7.53 but does not have a certificate of recoverable benefits that remains in force for at least 10 days.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] 7.57 The defendant should apply for a fresh certificate of recoverable benefits as soon as possible, notify the claimant that it has done so and must pay the amounts set out in paragraph 7.53 within 30 days of receiving the Court Proceedings Pack (Part A and Part B) Form from the claimant.

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > 7.53 Except where the claimant is a child the defendant must pay to the claimant—] 7.58 Where the defendant does not comply with paragraphs 7.55 or 7.57 the claimant may give written notice that the claim will no longer continue under this Protocol and start proceedings under Part 7 of the CPR.

## General provisions

[Pre-Action Protocol for Low Value Personal Injury (Employers’ Liability and Public Liability) Claims > General provisions] 7.59 Where the claimant gives notice to the defendant that the claim is unsuitable for this Protocol (for example, because there are complex issues of fact or law or where claimants contemplate applying for a Group Litigation Order) then the claim will no longer continue under this Protocol.  However, where the court considers that the claimant acted unreasonably in giving such notice it will award no more than the applicable fixed costs in rule 45.28(a).

## Stage 3 Procedure
